rationale: Both streaming schedules remain explicit memory-oriented alternatives. Retained RTX 5090 and H100 complete-endpoint evidence shows substantial runtime regressions against the deterministic baseline despite smaller arenas; the generated-reduction variant is still about 10.4x and 27.0x slower on the retained H100 workloads. Neither schedule belongs in default search.
revisit_condition: Reconsider only after a new bounded cooperative/persistent lowering shares producer work and passes independent numerical, resource, and complete-endpoint gates on an identified workload domain; lower memory or launch counts alone do not justify promotion.
